newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks could rise on Wall Street bull run.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks could rise on Wall Street bull run.

text.p: Local factors point to Taiwan share prices consolidating further on Friday, but brokers said Wall Street's dramatic bull run could light a fire in the recently quiet market.
On Thursday, the index ended down 7.72 points or 0.09 percent at 8,259.28. A 8,200-8,330 range was seen for Friday.
"Wall Street overnight should help boost the market," said independent analyst Michael Hung. "In particular, the late-day buying we saw on Thursday could continue."
National Securities analyst Oliver Fang was more cautious.
"Both local and foreign institutional investors were net sellers on Thursday, thus dampening sentiment," Fang said.
As institutions dumped semiconductor shares -- the sector seen with the best outlook among electronics -- electronics may consolidate anew after Thursday's strong rebound, Fang said.
"We'll see whether Taiwan Semiconductor can continue its limit-up move to boost the momentum," Fang said.
Leading chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor on Thursday rose the daily seven percent limit to T$91 on its ex-bonus issue date.
Financials were seen continuing recent weak performance, brokers said.
Several brokers said the current consolidation would be short-lived and expected the market to enter a firming trend.
